label: ⛰️ 안데스 파야이 — 30대 고원 후면
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Model: one woman in her thirties, curvy strong build, full hips and thighs, defined waist, black hair in two long braids.
Pose: photographed from behind at three-quarter angle, weight on one leg with the hip pushed out, head turned back over the shoulder toward the camera, one hand resting at the waist.

Body fully painted with: Andean pallay weaving — dense pickup-weave bands in crimson, ochre, black and white running horizontally across the body. Rows of inti sun figures, ch'unchu zigzag mountains, kinsa cruz stepped crosses, and tiny stylized llamas and birds, each band tightly packed against the next with narrow striped dividers between. No undyed ground anywhere.

Pigment applied directly on bare skin, matte, pores and skin texture visible.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in a thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
Hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.

Barefoot on dry grass.
Environment: a high altiplano slope, stone wall, distant peaks.
Lighting: hard low-angle mountain sun from the side, carving the curve of the back and hip, deep shadow on the far side, thin cold sky fill.
Style: documentary photography of textile craft. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
